adjudication.rationale: `parseRefreshTokenResponse` uses `minimumTokenResponseSchema` in sharing mode (APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT), which does not require/retain `refresh_token`, then forcibly sets `refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token = "refresh_token"` when missing. In `Office365CalendarService`, the merge `o365AuthCredentials = { ...o365AuthCredentials, ...(tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data) }` will overwrite the existing real `o365AuthCredentials.refresh_token` with that literal placeholder, and the subsequent `prisma.credential.update` persists it. This matches the finding: disabling sharing later would leave an invalid refresh token stored locally, breaking refresh and requiring re-auth.
